task_definition.task_description: Please look up Alice’s contact info, get the latest business news, turn it into a high-priority Business Travel Briefing for email, and save that briefing as a document. Then check the status of flight CA1234, prepare the business-class booking request for Alice Johnson, and book that flight if it’s available. After that, look up Hilton Tokyo, prepare an available deluxe-room stay request for Alice Johnson from 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-12, then get the hotel’s stay sheet and archive it as a high-priority Hotel Archive Packet for email.
